property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: Path on the local filesystem where the NameNode stores the namespace and transactions logs.

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Comma-separated list of paths on the local filesystem where the DataNode stores blocks.

property.name: dfs.namenode.http-address
property.description: The address and the base port where the dfs namenode web ui will listen on.

property.name: dfs.datanode.http-address
property.description: The address and the base port where the dfs datanode web ui will listen on.

property.name: dfs.permissions.enabled
property.description: If true, enable permission checking in HDFS.
